connector.name: Sub Agents MCP
connector.registryDescription: AI sub-agent delegation for Cursor, Claude, Codex, Gemini, GLM, Kimi, Grok, and OpenCode
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package sub-agents-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the shinpr account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: AGENTS_DIR
env.description: Absolute path to the directory containing agent definition files (.md or .txt)

env.name: AGENT_TYPE
env.description: Type of AI CLI to use: 'cursor', 'claude', 'gemini', 'codex', 'glm', 'kimi', 'grok', or 'opencode'

env.name: AGENT_MODEL
env.description: Optional model override applied to every sub-agent execution by this MCP server

env.name: AGENT_EFFORT
env.description: Optional backend-specific reasoning effort or model variant. Supported by codex, claude, glm, kimi, grok, and opencode.

env.name: CURSOR_API_KEY
env.description: API key for cursor-agent authentication (used only when AGENT_TYPE=cursor; passed via env, never via CLI args)

env.name: CLI_API_KEY
env.description: Provider API key for AGENT_TYPE=glm or kimi (passed to the claude binary via env, never via CLI args). Restart/reconnect the MCP server after changing it.

env.name: EXECUTION_TIMEOUT_MS
env.description: Maximum execution time for agents in milliseconds (default: 300000, max: 600000)

env.name: SESSION_ENABLED
env.description: Enable session management to maintain execution history across agent calls (default: false)

env.name: SESSION_DIR
env.description: Directory path for storing session files (default: .mcp-sessions in current working directory)

env.name: SESSION_RETENTION_DAYS
env.description: Number of days to retain session history before automatic cleanup (default: 7)

env.name: AGENTS_SETTINGS_PATH
env.description: Path to CLI settings file/directory. Claude: --settings arg, Cursor: CURSOR_CONFIG_DIR, Codex: CODEX_HOME. GLM/Kimi/Gemini/Grok/OpenCode not supported.
